# Air-Cooled Mechanical Services, LLC

> Heating & air conditioning based in Cibolo, Texas. Mark Rucker runs Air-Cooled Mechanical out of Cibolo. Reviewers say he answers after hours, shows up fast and explains every repair in plain words.

- Phone: (512) 644-0958
- Based in: Cibolo, TX
- Service area: Cibolo, Schertz, Converse, Universal City, Selma, New Braunfels
- Google rating: 5.0 from 38 reviews
- Request a quote: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/air-cooled-mechanical-services/quote.html
- Book a visit: https://vinaynay9.github.io/smb_fde/hs/air-cooled-mechanical-services/book.html

## Services
- AC repair: Mark finds the fault, shows you what he found and gets the cooling back on, often within hours of your call.
- Installation & unit replacement: When an old system is done, Mark lays out the options and installs the new one properly.
- Twice-yearly maintenance: Two visits a year that keep the AC and heat ready before the weather turns.
- Heating & furnace service: Gas furnaces checked, cleaned and brought back to safe, steady heat.
- Ductless mini-splits: Ductless mini-split systems installed and serviced on homes around Cibolo.
- Commercial rooftop units: Rooftop package units and commercial air handlers set, connected and kept running.

## About
Air-Cooled Mechanical Services is Mark Rucker's company, based on Hinge Path in Cibolo. Mark is the owner, and he is also the one who answers the phone, drives out and does the work, often with a helper alongside him. The business card lists four things: AC repair, installation, maintenance and unit replacement. In practice that covers home systems, mini-splits and furnaces as well as commercial rooftop units and air handlers. Many customers have kept Mark on twice-a-year maintenance for years, and some have called him at more than one house.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can I reach Air-Cooled after hours or on a Sunday?
  A: Yes. The business is listed as open 24 hours, and reviewers describe Mark answering after working hours and coming out on a Sunday.
- Q: Do you offer AC maintenance plans?
  A: Yes. Mark offers twice-a-year maintenance. One Cibolo-area customer has been on it for four years.
- Q: Do you work on commercial rooftop units?
  A: Yes. Mark installs and services rooftop package units and commercial air handlers, including crane-set units.
- Q: How will I know what is wrong with my system?
  A: Mark explains what he finds, takes photos of the problem and lays out your options before he fixes it.
- Q: Where are you based?
  A: 260 Hinge Path in Cibolo. Air-Cooled serves Cibolo, Schertz, Converse, Universal City, Selma and New Braunfels.
